Name: TestTimeout
Description: Maximum duration of one test case, SetUp included (hh:mm:ss). Read by the execution template.

Name: TearDownTimeout
Description: Maximum duration of the TearDown hook (hh:mm:ss). A TearDown that runs longer is stopped and logged; it never changes the test result.

Name: example_ApplicationUrl
Description: Example setting (a text value, here a URL). Remove or replace in a real project.

Name: example_Environment
Description: Example setting (a text value, here the target environment name). Remove or replace in a real project.
